torch: reuse unchanged project torch==2.5.1+cpu via declared PYTHONPATH
development_cases: four current authored examples (historical case excluded from this current-snapshot text interface), first-SHA current partial-flip trace example, and first3 SHA rows of each public source; no outcome or label selection
scope: Small development language diagnostic only, not complete Week2 language comparisons; same one-shot example, model, full evidence and 96-token single-candidate cap in all four conditions; no prompt changes after outputs
context_policy: No input truncation. If any condition exceeds the model context, skip that input for all conditions with an explicit reason. Cap-limited outputs remain marked and preserved.

methods.proposed_language_adapter: Extract only current observational assertions actually asserted in the original text, without correcting them. Put causal, action-model, historical, and unparsed content in unresolved. The fixed deterministic editor then repairs parsed claims.
methods.contradiction_reprompt: Revise the explanation against the supplied evidence, correcting contradictions and marking unknowns unresolved.
methods.RARR_inspired_supplied_evidence: Check each original assertion against the supplied ledger, then minimally revise unsupported content and preserve supported details. This is a single-pass supplied-evidence prompt adaptation, not RARR research/search reproduction.
methods.language_evidence_regeneration: Ignore the original explanation and generate current observational facts from the same supplied evidence, marking causes unknown.

trace_metadata_policy: Only observation IDs, facts, windows, visibility, kind and action are model-visible. Raw trace source paths and condition/seed provenance stay evaluator-only.
